# Bagseven

Operators sign in with World. Plans + checkout sessions settle USDT on Whitechain (WhiteWallet-ready) and mint living Arkiv entitlements. Humans and agents check/consume through `@bagseven/sdk`. Prepaid credit consumption does not require a mandate. New agent payments require a mandate and living entitlement.

Dashboard: /app (World login). Plans / checkouts / account. SDK: /app/sdk. Embed: /embed?token=. Checkout: /checkout?session=.

SDK: react (Provider, FeatureFlagGuard, BagsevenEmbed checkout) · node (createPlan, createCheckoutSession, checkEntitlement) · wallet (Whitechain)

MCP: bagseven_status, grant_status, check_entitlement, consume_entitlement, mint_with_world, buy_credits, create_checkout_session, paid_run, cancel_renewal, explain_denial, bagseven_fetch.
